turns.user: I validated an ordinary single ticket and transfer from metro M2 to M3, staying in the metro network and continuing forward.
turns.agent:
That sounds covered by the ordinary single-ticket rule in my 5 November 2026 snapshot: a change between metro lines in the same direction is permitted. So an M2-to-M3 transfer while staying within the metro network and continuing forward should be covered by the same validated ticket; a voluntary transfer to a surface route would normally require another ticket. BKK: Single ticket

This is snapshot-based guidance, not live verification; BKK’s current rule is authoritative.

turns.user: Now I want to take M3 back in the opposite direction. Can I keep using that ticket?
turns.agent:
No—not on that same ordinary single ticket, based on my 5 November 2026 snapshot. The M2-to-M3 change is permitted only when continuing in the same direction; reversing direction on M3 would be a separate ride, so you’d need another ticket. BKK: Single ticket
